limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
Activity windows cover whole helper calls, including model loading; phase-level attribution is unavailable.
CPU rates integrate sampled process ticks; new and disappearing processes have unknown deltas, never assumed idle.
Disk bytes sum non-partition device counters and can count multiple physical writes for one logical operation.
GPU flags use observed sample endpoints; unsampled activity is not ruled out.
Host runner and recorded docker launchers are orchestration, separate from unrelated work.

interpretation: MXFP4 remains below mx in both phases on both measured models.
Existing-type prefill changes are within the same-header layout-control range.
Q4_0 decode candidate/main changes +10.72 percent in block 0 and -1.05 in block 1; no stable gain established.
Q5_K_M decode candidate/main median is -3.21 percent, with block means -9.96 and -3.17; layout/main block means -9.85 and +0.13. Preserve the observed loss without claiming a cause.
All calls have GPU activity flags; 60 have unrelated CPU flags and 25 disk flags. Every call has process-coverage limitations. No sample was discarded or replaced.
Top1/logit-sum equality is diagnostic, not a replacement for raw-output identity or HF checks.
First-support speed allowance recorded by LDEV on 2026-09-29 at 22:57 is not a correctness waiver.

result.scope: Clean main6282500 versus CPU MXFP4f55f025a, raw full-vocabulary prompt/decode/64greedy identity on four existing quant mixtures, both caches. Correctness only; other CPU correctness checks may run concurrently. No timing claims.
